'''Cadgel Meadows''' was a stretch of open grassland on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]], and the site of the world's largest civilian [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. It was located close to [[Half-Axe Pass]].

==History==
{{Quote|There are so many ships in port. With all the refugees headed here, I expected the place to be deserted. If all of these ships are still here&mdash;''where'' did all the refugees go?|Dass Jennir|<ref name="DT 1" />}}
Near the end of the [[Cleansing of New Plympto|Cleansing]] of [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]], [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] fleeing the fighting were sent to the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]],<ref name="DT 1" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]'s largest civilian spaceport.<ref name="CSWE" /> After the battle of [[Half-Axe Pass]], however, the area was seized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], who captured all the refugees<ref name="DT 1" /> and sold them into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]].<ref name="CSWE" /> The spaceport was subsequently shut down by the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], and all [[Starship/Legends|starships]] docked there were grounded.<ref name="DT 2">[[Dark Times 2|''Dark Times'' 2]]</ref>

After surviving Half-Axe Pass, the fugitives [[Bomo Greenbark]] and [[Dass Jennir]] entered Cadgel Meadows and infiltrated the spaceport, stowing away on the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Uhumele]]''<ref name="DT 1" /> prior to the mass lift-off of all starships fleeing Imperial aggression.<ref name="DT 2" />
